model: pmacctd with the sfprobe plugin (sFlow v5 agent) on Alpine Linux 3.20

capture.command: exporter 192.168.128.5: pmacctd -f sfprobe.conf (live on eth0, sampling_rate 1) and tcpdump -i eth0 -U -w traffic.pcap with the same filter, while running 3x curl http://192.168.128.7/blob.bin (16 KiB), 1x curl http://192.168.128.7/index.html and 4x echo 'openmap flow lab datagram N' | nc -u -w1 192.168.128.7 5514. Receiver 192.168.128.6: tcpdump -i eth0 -U -w sflow-v5.pcap 'udp dst port 6343'.

files.name: sflow-v5.pcap
files.description: sFlow v5 datagrams as received on the wire: flow samples with raw packet header records (frame_length includes the 4-byte FCS, stripped=4)

files.name: traffic.pcap
files.description: the traffic pmacctd sampled (ground truth), recorded at the same time on the exporter

notes: Live export: pmacctd sampled every packet (rate 1) from eth0.
